title: Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer
description:
Oranzai Builders is a leading Turnkey Construction and Interior Design Company specializing in creating exceptional residential and commercial spaces. We are passionate about delivering innovative, functional, and aesthetically appealing environments that exceed client expectations.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a talented and passionate **Interior Designer** to join our growing team. The ideal candidate should have a strong design sense, experience in residential interior projects, and the ability to transform client requirements into creative and practical design solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand client requirements and translate them into innovative and functional interior design concepts.
* Develop space planning, furniture layouts, material selections, and design presentations.
* Collaborate closely with architects, project teams, and clients throughout the design process.
* Create and manage 3D visualizations, renderings, and presentation materials.
* Prepare detailed interior drawings and documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, and execution teams to ensure design intent is achieved.
* Conduct site visits and monitor project progress when required.
* Ensure timely delivery and successful execution of interior design projects.
* Stay updated with current design trends, materials, and industry best practices.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* Degree or Diploma in Interior Design or a related field.
* Minimum **2 years of professional experience** in residential interior design.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max, V\-Ray, Photoshop, or similar design software.
* Strong understanding of space planning, materials, finishes, and furniture design.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and client\-handling skills.
* Strong project coordination and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Fashion Designer
description:
Silent Limited is an expanding business group managing emerging apparel and lifestyle fashion brands. We are looking for a creative, detail\-oriented **Fashion Designer** to lead our retail store presence in **Thiruvalla** while actively driving design curation and collection development.

Role Overview

In this role, you will hold dual responsibility: managing the day\-to\-day operations and customer experience at our Thiruvalla retail outlet, and curating trendy collections for our fashion brands. Production is completely outsourced, meaning your primary focus will be on trend research, design conceptualization, sampling coordination, vendor management, and store\-level customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

* **Collection Design \& Curation:** Research current fashion trends, select fabrics, develop mood boards, and curate fresh seasonal collections for our brand portfolio.
* **Store Oversight \& Styling:** Manage the Thiruvalla retail store operations, ensure high standards of visual merchandising, and assist walk\-in clients with personalized styling and wardrobe advice.
* **Outsourced Production Coordination:** Liaise with external manufacturing units, tailors, and fabric vendors. Oversee sample development, fit approvals, quality checks, and production timelines.
* **Customer Insights \& Feedback:** Act as the direct bridge between the retail floor and design table, leveraging client feedback to guide new design launches.
* **Stock \& Inventory Control:** Track store inventory movement, fast\-selling designs, and stock replenishment needs.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Fashion Designing, Apparel Technology, or Fashion Merchandising.
* **Experience:** 0–3 years of experience in fashion designing, boutique management, or apparel retail (passionate freshers with strong creative portfolios are encouraged to apply).

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: Poster Designer cum Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Position:** Poster Designer cum Digital Marketing Executive  
**Department:** Marketing \& Creative  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** \[Location]  
**Reporting To:** Marketing Head / Management

Job Summary

We are looking for a **creative and result\-oriented Poster Designer cum Digital Marketing Executive** who can handle both **graphic design and digital marketing activities**. The candidate will be responsible for creating engaging promotional creatives, managing social media platforms, executing digital campaigns, and supporting lead\-generation and brand\-building activities.

* Design posters, social media creatives, banners, advertisements, brochures, presentations, and promotional materials.
* Create creatives for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
* Develop creative concepts based on campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
* Edit images, videos, reels, and other marketing content when required.

**Digital Marketing**

* Manage and maintain company social media accounts.
* Plan and publish regular social media content.
* Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns.
* Handle **Meta Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant advertising platforms**.
* Support lead\-generation campaigns and monitor campaign performance.
* Track engagement, reach, leads, conversions, and other key marketing metrics.
* Research competitors, market trends, and relevant content opportunities.

**Content \& Campaign Coordination**

* Coordinate with the sales and management teams to understand campaign requirements.
* Prepare creatives and content according to marketing calendars and campaigns.
* Support promotions, events, product launches, offers, and corporate communications.
* Coordinate with external vendors, photographers, videographers, and other marketing partners when required.

Required Skills

* Good understanding of **social media marketing and digital advertising**.
* Knowledge of **Meta Business Suite / Ads Manager and Google Ads**.
* Basic video editing and reel creation skills.
* Good understanding of social media trends and visual content.
* Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in **Graphic Design, Digital Marketing, Marketing, Media, or a related field**.
* Previous experience in graphic design and digital marketing will be preferred.
* Candidates with a strong **portfolio of posters, social media creatives, campaigns, and digital content** will be given preference.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Quality and creativity of marketing creatives
* Timely delivery of posters and campaign materials
* Social media growth and engagement
* Lead generation and campaign performance
* Ad campaign optimization
* Content consistency and brand visibility
* Timely execution of marketing campaigns

**Ideal Candidate:** A creative professional who can independently handle **design \+ social media \+ digital advertising \+ campaign execution**, with the ability to convert marketing requirements into attractive and effective digital content.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month
